resources.string: Knot - a feature extension module for LINE
Language used by Knot\'s own screens and dialogs. Choose \"System default\" to follow the device language.
Restore all settings to their defaults?
LINE has to restart before these settings take effect. Restart now?
⚠ Knot: no storage location is set. Tap here to choose one.
This version of LINE is not supported.
Restore chat history from this backup? All current data will be overwritten and the app will restart when it finishes.
Delete all read history for this chat?
Add \"Read avoidance\" to the plus menu
Lets you turn read avoidance on and off from the \"+\" menu at the top right of the Chats tab. When it is on, a \"Mark read after sending\" option appears as well.
Records who read each message and when. Open it from the book icon at the top of the chat screen.
Keeps messages on your device even after the sender unsends them. Unsent messages get an icon you can tap to see when they were withdrawn.

Adds an ⓘ icon to the top right of a friend\'s profile screen. Tapping it shows the MID and the dates the friend was added, favorited, and last updated their profile. Entries with no record show \"—\".
Skips the automatic compression and resizing applied when sending photos, so they are sent at maximum quality — better than LINE\'s own \"High quality\" setting.
Removes the 5-minute limit on video uploads so you can send longer videos.
Re-enables the mute message feature that was removed from LINE Labs.
Uses your device\'s default camera app instead of the camera built into LINE.
Silences the shutter sound of LINE\'s built-in camera. Has no effect while the system camera is in use.
Tap the magnifier icon inside the search box to pick a member and search only their messages.
Lowers the minimum in-chat search length from two characters to one.
Adds seconds to the time shown next to each message (for example 12:34 → 12:34:56).
Add a select-all button when deleting messages
Adds a button at the bottom of the message deletion screen that selects or deselects every message.
Saves the previous text whenever a message is edited and adds \"Edit history\" to the long-press menu of edited messages.
Delete the edit history of this message?
On patched builds of LINE the system message for a new announcement shows an empty name (\"announced this\"). This restores the correct name.
Hide Agent i in chat rooms permanently
Always hides the Agent i entry in the chat room message field. LINE normally only lets you hide it for 30 days; with this option it stays hidden regardless of that setting.
Open links in the default browser
Opens URLs in your system default browser instead of the in-app browser.
Hides the ads shown at the top of the chat list, on the Home screen, and elsewhere.
Hides the recommended content and feed shown on the Home screen (including HOME26).
Hides the service list shown on the Home screen.
Hide the accordion at the top of Home
Hides the accordion panel (LYP benefits and similar) between the search bar and the friend list at the top of the Home tab.
Hides the VOOM tab in the bottom bar.
Hides the News/Calls tab in the bottom bar.
Hides the Apps tab in the bottom bar.
Hides the Shopping tab in the bottom bar.
Hides the Wallet tab in the bottom bar.
Widens the touch target of the bottom tabs so they are easier to hit.
Hides the text under the bottom tab icons.
Changes which Home tab variant is used. Choose \"HOME\" to go back to the classic Home screen.
Hides the \"AI Friends\" button at the top right of the Chats tab.
Hides the \"Agent i\" button on every tab together with the \"Show Agent i in chat rooms\" toggle in the chat room \"+\" menu.
Hides the \"OpenChat\" button at the top right of the Chats tab.
Hides the \"Calendar\" button at the top right of the Chats tab.
Hides the \"Album\" button shown at the top right of the Chats tab on sub-devices.
Applies the selected font file across the whole app. Restart the app for it to take effect.
Choose the font file (.ttf / .otf) to use.
Applies the AMOLED theme. You have to turn off \"Apply the Black theme in dark mode\". Menus and dialogs are matched to the AMOLED palette as well.
Keep the dark UI while a theme is applied

Keeps long-press menus and dialogs dark — they otherwise turn light when a theme is applied — regardless of the \"Apply the Black theme in dark mode\" setting. Not needed when \"Apply the AMOLED theme\" is on, which already covers it.
Shows the \"Themes\" entry that LINE hides when you are signed in on a sub-device. Note: the theme shop cannot be opened; buy themes on your main device.
Notifies you about reactions to your messages. Note: they are delivered when you open the app. If LINE is running as a foreground service, they arrive even while LINE is closed.
Groups up to seven messages in a single notification instead of replacing the previous one.
Removes the \"Mute\" action button from LINE notifications.
Fixes the crash when opening \"Chats\" in LINE\'s own settings on patched builds.
Hands LINE\'s FCM notification handling directly to the service, working around notifications that stop arriving after about a minute on non-rooted devices.

Chooses how FCM Fix works. Legacy (keep Legy) keeps LINE\'s own streaming connection alive to deliver notifications. FIS (certificate spoof) spoofs the signature as the official certificate when the FCM token is issued.
Requests a new FCM token for LINE when notifications are not arriving.
Could not start FCM token re-registration
Always run LINE as a foreground service
May increase battery use, but keeps FCM Fix working after the task is killed. Useful when notifications stop arriving on non-rooted devices. You may need to force stop or pause it when updating Knot.
Reports the app version as 15.12.2 during unsend only, restoring the 24-hour limit instead of one hour.
Always reports the app version as 15.12.2. Do not use this unless you have a specific reason.
Works around failures on patched builds of LINE, such as font downloads and biometric authentication.
Choose the directory where the module keeps its settings and other files.
Restores every module setting to its default state.
Backs up your current chat history to the storage location.
Restores chat history from a backup file. Your current history is overwritten.
This permanent notification can be hidden from the notification settings.
The developers accept no responsibility for any disadvantage resulting from the use of this module. Use it at your own risk.

Enable the module, then restart the LINE app.\n\nYou can configure the features and choose where data is stored by long-pressing the settings (gear) icon at the top right of LINE\'s Home screen, or from the extra entries inside LINE\'s settings.
